si_reagent_molar_mass_ladder.what_it_pins: the two INTERMEDIATES are the load-bearing rows: 2-(tetradecyloxy)ethanol pins the O17 tails' chain at C14 and dodecyl 2-pyridyl disulfide pins the 16S-S tails' chain at C12, each to <=0.3 %. Three starting-material lines are sloppier by up to 35 %, which is why the chain length is taken from the intermediates and the discrepancy is logged in 08_contradictions.csv.

repeated_formulation_identity.what_it_is: 16:4:1:1 is drawn three times, once in each sub-series. Three independent window detections and three independent bar_top calls must land on the same row. This is an unprinted identity the authors drew, not a recomputed marginal of our own read.

untreated_viability_is_100.what_it_is: Figure S2b is 'Cell viability (%)' and the SI says the viability is calculated relative to untreated cells, so the UT bar MUST be exactly 100. The authors drew that round number and never printed it; it is external to our pipeline in a way a recomputed marginal is not.

per_claim.claim: SI section 6: 'the best ... lipidoid concentration was found to be ... 30 ug/mL'
SI section 6: 'the best delivery time ... ~6 h'
per_claim.note: the panel has no 6 h bar; 7 h is its maximum and 5 h its neighbour, so '~6 h' is consistent with either. Recorded as consistent, not as exact.

axis_calibration_and_loo.why_loo: calibrate's max-residual test is weak against a SINGLE bad tick; loo_residuals has no leverage masking. Both are reported.

bar_flank_agreement.what_it_is: every bar carries a symmetric s.d. whisker with a cap. A cap is centred, so it is in NEITHER flank; a flank delta of 0 on all bars is the evidence that no cap was read as a top (error class 32, F-018).

z_normalisation.why_not_1e_9: Experiment_value is stored at 6 dp, as the corpus does; the residual below is that rounding and nothing else
z_normalisation.convention: per-experiment z-score of log10, population sd (CLAUDE.md s3)

c10_anchor_gate.what_the_seed_is: one Michael arm moved from the amine nitrogen onto imidazole C2. Molecular formula C44H83N3O4S2 and exact mass 781.582500 are IDENTICAL to 6 dp, so no mass check can see it; the skeleton InChIKey changes from OLOIOPYNTGMAAP to GNLMIRXUIQYCQW.

figS1_mass_confirms_head_9322.what_changed: the first pass refused this figure outright. With no hypothesis a ~4 Da/px axis cannot pin a formula, which was true; with a head recovered from the corpus the question becomes WHICH of three candidates 20 and 30 Da apart, and the axis answers that decisively.

figure_S1_mass_spectra._status: PARTLY SUPERSEDED 2026-11-10. The GLYPH read is still refused -- the labels really are illegible. What is no longer refused is the panel: with head 9322 recovered from the corpus, the base-peak position measured against the m/z axis decides between the three candidate labels, and 2 of 6 panels calibrate under criteria that cannot be tuned to the answer. See 09_figS1_mass_test.json and 08_retracted_suspicions.csv R-06.
figure_S1_mass_spectra.still_refused: 4 of 6 panels: no glyph gap in 2..12 yields 10 tick labels that are uniformly spaced to 4 % AND carry the 3-digit/4-digit width signature. The threshold was NOT loosened to recover them (O17S misses at 4.65 % nonuniformity, O16B at 18.3 %, EC18 at 37.8 %, N16B never reaches 10 boxes). So D-3 (is O16B the same as O16S-S) is still OPEN.
figure_S1_mass_spectra.panel: Figure S1, ESI-MS of head 9322 with six tails
figure_S1_mass_spectra.verdict: ILLEGIBLE. The 9322-O17O base peak reads as 784.73 / 794.75 / 764.73 with no way to decide between them.
figure_S1_mass_spectra.consequence: head 9322's molecular formula cannot be solved, so the four Figure S3 delivery values for 9322-O17S have no molecule and none of the seventeen 93xx analogue heads can be enumerated.
figure_S1_mass_spectra.what_the_first_pass_got_wrong: it concluded that because the axis cannot PIN a formula it could not TEST one. Those are different questions. ~3.9 Da/px still separates hypotheses 14 Da apart at a 3.6 px margin. The refusal was correct for the read and wrong as a stopping point.
figure_S1_mass_spectra.what_is_still_true: the axis cannot separate O from S (16 Da, ~4 px is marginal) and cannot separate O16B from N16B (1.97 Da, 0.5 px). Those remain unresolved.
